_meta.description: The Socket.IO events a phone may emit (allowed true, with an example payload) and the ones it must never emit (allowed false). Every listed event has a handler on the dashboard; the table itself is the contract and has no builder.

drone_command.notes: command is always "land"; offered for every drone in every state

forbidden_manual_command.notes: moves, rotations and takeoff by hand; laptop only (Land goes through drone_command)

forbidden_manual_take_control.notes: a phone link roams and sleeps; the controller-gone path would become the normal path

forbidden_plan_fleet.notes: the laptop is the mission console; Start must carry the plan the browser shows

forbidden_restart_dashboard.notes: restarts the ground's pipeline; laptop only

forbidden_set_ceiling_settings.notes: the ceiling and altitude slots are edited on the laptop only

forbidden_set_reasoning_provider.notes: the reasoning backend is chosen on the laptop only

forbidden_set_stream_video.notes: video streaming changes every edge's bandwidth; laptop only

forbidden_set_target.notes: target photos and embeddings are managed on the laptop

forbidden_start_fleet.notes: starting a mission makes drones take off; laptop only

forbidden_start_search.notes: starts a local search pattern that moves a drone; laptop only

get_ceiling_settings.notes: on every connect and on refresh

get_detection_profiles.notes: on every connect and on refresh

get_fleet_status.notes: on every connect and on refresh

get_manual_status.notes: on every connect and on refresh

get_reasoning_provider.notes: on every connect and on refresh

land_all.notes: always offered while connected; never disabled by any drone state

manual_resume_search.notes: only for a drone whose control_mode is "held" while fleet_status.manual_controlled is null

set_detection_profile.notes: only when detection_profiles.controls_enabled is true; an empty profile follows the fleet default

set_fleet_detection_profile.notes: only when detection_profiles.controls_enabled is true; an empty profile clears the default
